note: USFS (Flathead NF, Hungry Horse-Glacier View RD) primitive campground at ~5,500 ft on Red Meadow Lake. Forest Service directions: 41 miles north of Columbia Falls on County Road 486, then 11 miles west on Forest Service Road 115, or from the west through Stillwater State Forest. 'Access opening date varies' (call the district for conditions). Access road is rough dirt but passable with caution — campers report bringing travel trailers. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Feb 25, 2026): confirmed free, 16-day limit, vault toilet, no drinking water; site count corrected 6 -> 3 (plus 3 day-use picnic sites). Not stated: reservations/FCFS (derived FCFS left), trailer length, season (only 'access opening date varies'). Alerts: only the NCDE food-storage order and wilderness restrictions. Note trimmed of restated values and the wrong site count.
